notes: All four refs described wrong objects/locations: U1 yellow flag on a tall pole behind the fence (not on the boat), U2 is the Thai national flag (not cloth), U3 a blue plastic drum (not wooden), U4 the blue name plate on the hull (not a riverbank sign). Masks verified correct and unchanged.

spec.ref: the yellow flag on the tall pole behind the fence at the right

units.ref_zh: 右侧栅栏后高杆上的黄色旗帜
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右侧栅栏后高杆上的黄色旗帜的颜色改为红色。
units.reason: Masked flag (x1566-1712) flies on a pole rising behind the shore fence, not at the boat bow. Another small yellow flag is at the far left, hence 'at the right'.

spec.ref: the red, white and blue Thai flag on the pole behind the boat

units.ref_zh: 小船后方旗杆上的红白蓝泰国国旗
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将小船后方旗杆上的红白蓝泰国国旗替换为一面白色三角旗。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一面白色三角旗。
units.reason: Mask is the Thai tricolour flag on a pole, not a cloth on the boat; payload changed to a different flag shape (triangular pennant).

spec.ref: the blue plastic drum on the boat deck

units.ref_zh: 船甲板上的蓝色塑料桶
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除船甲板上的蓝色塑料桶。
units.reason: Clean crop: it is a blue plastic drum standing on the deck, not a wooden barrel.

spec.ref: the blue name plate with white Thai lettering on the boat's hull

units.ref_zh: 船身上写有白色泰文的蓝色名牌
units.instruction_ref_zh: 在船身上写有白色泰文的蓝色名牌上加上一张黄色小贴纸。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一张黄色小贴纸。
units.reason: Mask (x613-803, y984-1038) is the name plate on the boat's hull side; a second blue plate on the stern roof is not on the hull.
